slice: Phase 12 Tribal Intel generator (spec 23): repurpose the read-only Tribal Intel (Training Documents) screen on all three platforms into a manual AI-feed upload tool. Auntie types notes, attaches screenshots/files (Cloudinary), targets a Kinfolk or Kin via real directory pickers, and the saved entry is enqueued as a reconcile source so the nightly pipeline folds it into Dossier.rawSummary / Kin411.rawSummary / AI blurbs. Backend = three new MyTribe admin callables (create/update/delete) writing the existing `training_documents` collection with new attachment + target + reconcileStatus fields; reconcile = add `training_documents` to the Python pipeline's LOG_COLLECTIONS as a `note` channel.
summary: Turns the three read-only Tribal Intel screens into a write tool. Auntie can create/edit/delete a Tribal Intel entry with free notes, Cloudinary file/screenshot attachments, and a real Kinfolk-or-Kin target picker; the entry persists to Firestore `training_documents` via new admin Cloud Functions and is queued for the existing nightly reconcile pipeline (Python), which folds it into the targeted client's Dossier and the targeted pet's Kin411 plus the AI-generated blurbs. The UI honestly surfaces "queued for reconcile" and never fakes an updated dossier; every gated affordance flips on only once its callable exists.

backend.plan:
Build three new MyTribe admin callables in functions/src/admin, registered in index.ts, each following the createKinCareSession.ts pattern (onCall {region:'us-central1', cors:TRIBETAILS_CORS, secrets:['SENTRY_DSN']} + wrapAdminCallable + initSentry + zod parse + HttpsError on ZodError + writeAuditEntry + logEvent). Collection is `training_documents` (matches android repo l.909 + Firestore). EXTEND the doc schema with new fields beyond the current TrainingDocument: targetType ('KINFOLK'|'KIN'), targetKinfolkId, targetKinId (optional), attachments: [{storageUrl, cloudinaryPublicId, fileType, mimeType, fileName}], plus reconcileStatus:'pending', reconcileNotes:'', reconciledAt:'' (so the nightly pipeline picks it up). Keep existing fields (title, content, communicationType, kinfolkRef [now derived/legacy], uploadedAt, notes).

1) functions/src/admin/createTrainingDocument.ts: Args = z.object({ title: z.string().max(200).default(''), content: z.string().max(20000).default(''), notes: z.string().max(4000).default(''), communicationType: z.string().max(120).default('note'), targetType: z.enum(['KINFOLK','KIN']), targetKinfolkId: z.string().min(1).max(120), targetKinId: z.string().max(120).optional(), attachments: z.array(z.object({ storageUrl: z.string().url(), cloudinaryPublicId: z.string().min(1), fileType: z.string().max(20), mimeType: z.string().max(120), fileName: z.string().max(300) })).max(25).default([]) }).refine(a => a.title.trim() || a.content.trim() || a.attachments.length, 'Provide a title, content, or at least one attachment'). Handler: uid guard; db().collection('training_documents').add({ ...fields, kinfolkRef: targetKinfolkId, reconcileStatus:'pending', uploadedAt: serverTimestamp/ISO, createdBy:uid, createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }); writeAuditEntry({ event: AUDIT_EVENTS.CREATE_TRAINING_DOCUMENT, severity:'info', actorRole:'AUNTIE', actorUid:uid, payload:{ docId: ref.id, targetType, targetKinfolkId, targetKinId, attachmentCount } }); return { ok:true, docId: ref.id }.
2) functions/src/admin/updateTrainingDocument.ts: Args adds docId: z.string().min(1); same body shape; db().collection('training_documents').doc(docId).set({...patch, reconcileStatus:'pending', updatedAt: serverTimestamp}, {merge:true}) (re-queue on edit so reconcile re-folds); AUDIT_EVENTS.UPDATE_TRAINING_DOCUMENT.
3) functions/src/admin/deleteTrainingDocument.ts: Args = z.object({ docId: z.string().min(1) }); db().collection('training_documents').doc(docId).delete(); AUDIT_EVENTS.DELETE_TRAINING_DOCUMENT. errorHandling: Fail-loud on every platform, no fakes. (1) Callables: zod ZodError -> HttpsError('invalid-argument', {validationErrors}) per createKinCareSession.ts ll.43-50; missing uid -> HttpsError('unauthenticated'); wrapAdminCallable enforces admin claim and rejects non-admins; every write is sealed by writeAuditEntry. (2) Attachment upload: uploadMedia already returns WriteResult.Err with the underlying message on all three (wasm 'Admin sign-in required before media upload', jvm same, android manager error) — surface it in a red AuntieBanner and block Save until at least the text fields are valid; never persist a doc referencing a failed upload. (3) Save result: WriteResult.Err / callable HttpsError -> red error banner with the server message; success -> a HONEST 'Queued for reconcile — the dossier and 411 update on the next reconcile pass, not instantly' Suggestion banner. NEVER render a fabricated updated Dossier.rawSummary in the UI. (4) Reconcile pipeline keeps its existing fail-loud contract: claude_merge raises on empty/LLM error and marks the source doc reconcileStatus='error' with a note (ll.418-429); a note with no resolvable targetKinfolkId is marked 'skipped' with a reason (ll.387-396) — surfaced back on the card via reconcileStatus/reconcileNotes so Auntie sees skipped/errored intel. (5) Delete: confirm-dialog copy states reconcile cannot retroactively unmerge already-folded text (no silent pretense of full removal).

risks: (1) TrainingDocument deserialization: the new attachments array + target fields must round-trip through each platform's Firestore->model mapping (wasm hand-rolled JSON, jvm JvmFirestoreRest, android toObjects). If any mapping is field-explicit, missing fields silently read as empty — verify each platformTrainingDocsStream maps the new keys. (2) Reconcile cannot read image bytes: attachments are cited as provenance only; the prompt must not claim to have analyzed photos (avoid fabricated intel). (3) Delete does not unmerge already-folded dossier/411 text — surface honestly. (4) Retiring android's client-side createTrainingDocument (ll.913-928) for the callable changes the security posture (now admin-claim gated server-side) — confirm Firestore rules for `training_documents` deny direct client writes after the switch so the only path is the callable. (5) entityType 'TRIBAL_INTEL' is new for uploadMedia; the sign-upload backend folders by entityId so it accepts it, but confirm no allow-list on entityType. (6) Edit re-queues reconcileStatus='pending' which re-folds content — acceptable but means a doc edited many times re-merges; bound via the existing per-run cap.
